subject: Biology
title: Biological Classification
summary: R.H. Whittaker (1969) ne five kingdom diye — Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia — cell structure, body organisation, nutrition ka tarika, reproduction aur phylogenetic relationships ke base par.
Monera prokaryotes hain (bacteria, cyanobacteria, archaebacteria, mycoplasma). Protista unicellular eukaryotes (chrysophytes, dinoflagellates, euglenoids, slime moulds, protozoans).
Fungi heterotrophic hain, chitin wali cell walls aur hyphae ke saath; spores aur fruiting bodies se Phycomycetes, Ascomycetes, Basidiomycetes aur Deuteromycetes mein classify hote hain.
Virus, viroid, prions aur lichen five-kingdom scheme mein fit nahi hote: virus nucleoprotein particles hain jo host cell ke bahar inert rehte hain.

formulas.name: Two-kingdom vs five-kingdom
formulas.formula: Linnaeus: Plantae + Animalia;  Whittaker (1969): Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia
formulas.mistake: Two-kingdom grouping ne prokaryotes ko eukaryotes ke saath aur unicellular ko multicellular ke saath rakh diya tha — isliye galat tha.

formulas.name: Five-kingdom comparison (Whittaker)
formulas.formula: Monera: prokaryotic, non-cellulosic wall (polysaccharide + amino acid), cellular body, autotrophic or heterotrophic;  Protista: eukaryotic, wall in some, cellular (unicellular) body, autotrophic or heterotrophic;  Fungi: eukaryotic, wall of chitin (no cellulose), multicellular/loose tissue, heterotrophic (saprophytic/parasitic);  Plantae: eukaryotic, cellulose wall, tissue/organ level, autotrophic;  Animalia: eukaryotic, no cell wall, tissue/organ/organ-system level, heterotrophic (holozoic)
formulas.when: Kingdoms ko body organisation ki complexity ke order mein lagaana (Monera → Protista → Fungi → Plantae → Animalia).

formulas.name: Archaebacteria
formulas.formula: halophiles (salty areas), thermoacidophiles (hot springs), methanogens (marshes, cattle gut → methane/biogas)
formulas.mistake: Inki cell wall structure doosre bacteria se alag hai — isi se extreme conditions jhel paate hain.

formulas.name: Cyanobacteria
formulas.formula: photosynthetic autotrophs with chlorophyll a; many fix nitrogen in heterocysts (Nostoc, Anabaena); form blooms in polluted water

formulas.name: Mycoplasma
formulas.formula: no cell wall, smallest living cells, can survive without oxygen, many are pathogenic

formulas.name: Protist groups
formulas.formula: chrysophytes (diatoms, desmids — silica walls, diatomaceous earth);  dinoflagellates (red tides, Gonyaulax);  euglenoids (pellicle, mixotrophic);  slime moulds (saprophytic, plasmodium, spores);  protozoans (amoeboid, flagellated, ciliated, sporozoans)

formulas.name: Protozoan examples
formulas.formula: amoeboid — Amoeba, Entamoeba;  flagellated — Trypanosoma (sleeping sickness);  ciliated — Paramoecium;  sporozoans — Plasmodium (malaria)

formulas.name: Fungal classes
formulas.formula: Phycomycetes: aseptate coenocytic, zoospores/aplanospores, oospores/zygospores (Mucor, Rhizopus, Albugo);  Ascomycetes: septate, conidia, ascospores in asci (Penicillium, yeast, Neurospora, morels, truffles);  Basidiomycetes: basidiospores, no asexual spores (Agaricus, Ustilago, Puccinia);  Deuteromycetes: only asexual stage known (Alternaria, Colletotrichum, Trichoderma)

formulas.name: Fungal reproduction
formulas.formula: plasmogamy → karyogamy → meiosis;  dikaryon (n + n) stage in ascomycetes and basidiomycetes

formulas.name: Viruses
formulas.formula: nucleoprotein: DNA or RNA + protein coat (capsid made of capsomeres);  plant viruses usually ssRNA, animal viruses ssRNA/dsRNA/dsDNA, bacteriophages usually dsDNA
formulas.note: D.J. Ivanowsky (1892) ne TMV dhoondha; M.W. Beijerinck ne fluid ko contagium vivum fluidum kaha; W.M. Stanley ne viruses ko crystallise kiya.

formulas.name: Viroids and prions
formulas.formula: viroid: free RNA without protein coat (T.O. Diener, 1971, potato spindle tuber);  prion: abnormally folded protein (BSE/mad cow disease, CJD)

formulas.name: Lichens
formulas.formula: symbiotic association of algae (phycobiont, food) and fungi (mycobiont, shelter, water); good pollution indicators — do not grow in polluted areas

examples.title: Kaunsa kingdom?
examples.problem: Euglena mein chlorophyll hai par andhere mein heterotroph ki tarah rehta hai. Kaunsa kingdom?
examples.solution: Protista (euglenoids). Cell wall ki jagah pellicle hai aur mixotrophic hai, isliye na plants mein fit na animals mein.

examples.title: Jiska sexual stage pata nahi
examples.problem: Alternaria aur Trichoderma kis class mein, aur kyun?
examples.solution: Deuteromycetes (imperfect fungi): sirf asexual (conidial) stage pata hai. Sexual stage milne par Ascomycetes ya Basidiomycetes mein shift ho jaate hain.

examples.title: Red tide
examples.solution: Gonyaulax jaise laal dinoflagellates ke tezi se badhne se; inke toxins machhliyon aur doosre marine animals ko maar sakte hain.

examples.title: Biogas bacteria
examples.problem: Kaunse bacteria biogas banate hain, aur kahan rehte hain?
examples.solution: Methanogens (archaebacteria) — cattle ke rumen aur marshy areas mein; cellulose-rich material se methane banate hain.

examples.title: Virus vs living
examples.problem: Viruses ko obligate parasites kyun kehte hain?
examples.solution: Host cell ke bahar ye inert, crystallise hone wale particles hain. Host ke andar uski machinery lekar replicate karte hain, aksar host cell ko maar dete hain.

examples.title: Rust aur smut
examples.problem: Wheat rust aur smut kaunsi fungi se? Class?
examples.solution: Rust: Puccinia; smut: Ustilago. Dono Basidiomycetes.

topics.title: Eubacteria nutrition
topics.explain: Zyadatar bacteria heterotrophs hain (decomposers, nitrogen fixers, pathogens). Kuch autotrophs: photosynthetic (cyanobacteria) ya chemosynthetic (nitrates aur ammonia jaise inorganic substances ko oxidise karte, nutrient recycling mein madad). Bacteria mainly fission se reproduce karte hain; DNA bhi exchange karte hain (conjugation, transformation, transduction).

topics.title: Diseases caused by bacteria
topics.explain: Cholera, typhoid, tetanus, citrus canker. Bacteria dahi, antibiotics aur nitrogen fixation (Rhizobium) mein bhi use hote hain.

topics.title: Slime moulds
topics.explain: Saprophytic protists jo achhi conditions mein plasmodium naam ka aggregate banate hain jo kai feet tak fail sakta hai. Buri conditions mein spores wale fruiting bodies banate hain; spores ki asli walls hoti hain aur saalon tak bache rehte hain.

topics.title: Kingdom Fungi general features
topics.explain: Heterotrophic: saprophytic, parasitic ya symbiotic (lichen, mycorrhiza). Hyphae milkar mycelium; cell walls chitin aur polysaccharides ki. Yeast unicellular. Asexual spores: conidia, sporangiospores, zoospores; sexual spores: oospores, ascospores, basidiospores.

topics.title: Kingdom Plantae and Animalia in the five-kingdom scheme
topics.explain: Plantae: eukaryotic, chlorophyll wale, zyadatar autotrophic, cellulose walls (kuch partially heterotrophic: insectivorous plants aur Cuscuta jaise parasites). Animalia: heterotrophic, multicellular, cell walls nahi, food glycogen ya fat ki tarah store.

topics.title: Three-domain system
topics.explain: Carl Woese ne Monera ko Archaebacteria aur Eubacteria mein baanta — teen domains (Archaea, Bacteria, Eukarya) ke andar chhe kingdoms.

ratta: Whittaker 1969: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia.
Methanogens → biogas;  halophiles → salt;  thermoacidophiles → hot springs.
Mycoplasma: no cell wall, smallest cell.
Diatoms → diatomaceous earth;  Gonyaulax → red tide.
Phyco: aseptate;  Asco: ascus;  Basidio: no asexual spores;  Deutero: only asexual.
TMV: Ivanowsky;  viroid: Diener 1971;  prion → mad cow.
N₂-fixers: Nostoc, Anabaena, Oscillatoria (cyanobacteria), Azotobacter (free-living), Rhizobium (symbiotic);  Volvox (green alga) cannot fix N₂.
Body organisation: Monera → Protista → Fungi → Plantae → Animalia.
